infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ResQRoute-A needs your location to detect emergencies and find nearest hospitals, police, ambulances, and towing services.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ResQRoute-A uses background location to monitor speed-drop and provide live tracking to trusted contacts during an active SOS.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: ResQRoute-A analyzes gyroscope and accelerometer data to automatically detect potential vehicle accidents or falls.
